cards.front: Recall a key point about Cell Structure and Function
cards.back: Nucleus: DNA, nucleolus; Mitochondria: respiration, cristae; RER/SER: protein/lipid synthesis; Golgi: modification, packaging; Lysosomes: hydrolytic enzymes; Chloroplasts: photosynthesis; Vacuole: turgor

cards.front: Recall a key point about Cell Structure and Function
cards.back: Prokaryotes: no nucleus, 70S ribosomes, circular DNA, plasmids, cell wall (peptidoglycan); Eukaryotes: 80S ribosomes, linear DNA, membrane-bound organelles

cards.front: Recall a key point about Cell Structure and Function
cards.back: Fluid mosaic: phospholipid bilayer, proteins (integral/peripheral), cholesterol, glycoproteins; Transport: simple diffusion, facilitated (channel/carrier), active (Na⁺/K⁺ pump), endo/exocytosis

cards.front: Recall a key point about Cell Structure and Function
cards.back: Cell cycle: interphase (G₁,S,G₂), M phase (mitosis: PMAT), cytokinesis; Meiosis: two divisions, crossing over (prophase I), independent assortment -> genetic variation

cards.front: Recall a key point about Cell Structure and Function
cards.back: Tissues: groups of similar cells; Organs: multiple tissues; Systems: multiple organs
